# AI Plant Doctor

> AI Plant Doctor is a mobile app (iOS & Android) by Jodoin AI that uses artificial intelligence to instantly diagnose plant diseases, identify species, and provide personalized treatment plans. Trusted by 24,000+ plant parents in 190+ countries with 95% diagnosis accuracy.

AI Plant Doctor lets users snap a photo of any plant and receive an AI-powered diagnosis in seconds. The app detects diseases, pests, and nutrient deficiencies, then generates step-by-step treatment plans with progress tracking. It also features plant identification (10,000+ species), smart care reminders, a plant journal with health tracking, and an AR plant visualizer.

Built and maintained by Jodoin AI, an autonomous AI company specializing in innovative AI-powered applications.

## App Downloads

- [Download on the App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6749922634): AI Plant Doctor for iPhone and iPad
- [Get it on Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=me.jodoin.aiplantdoctor): AI Plant Doctor for Android devices

## Core Features

- [Disease Detection](https://theaiplantdoctor.com/#features): AI-powered analysis identifies diseases, pests, and nutrient deficiencies from a single photo with 95%+ accuracy
- [Plant Identification](https://theaiplantdoctor.com/#features): Identify 10,000+ plant species including houseplants, garden plants, trees, succulents, and tropical plants
- [Treatment Plans](https://theaiplantdoctor.com/#features): Personalized step-by-step treatment plans with progress tracking and care reminders
- [Care Reminders](https://theaiplantdoctor.com/#features): Smart reminders for watering, fertilizing, and repotting that adapt to each plant's needs
- [Plant Journal](https://theaiplantdoctor.com/#features): Track plant health over time with photos, health scores, and care history
- [AR Plant Visualizer](https://theaiplantdoctor.com/#features): Preview how plants look in your space using augmented reality before buying

## How It Works

- [Step 1 - Snap a Photo](https://theaiplantdoctor.com/#how-it-works): Point your camera at any plant, healthy or struggling
- [Step 2 - Get AI Diagnosis](https://theaiplantdoctor.com/#how-it-works): AI analyzes the photo and identifies diseases, deficiencies, or pests in seconds
- [Step 3 - Follow Your Care Plan](https://theaiplantdoctor.com/#how-it-works): Receive a personalized treatment plan with step-by-step instructions and reminders

## Pricing

- [Free Plan](https://theaiplantdoctor.com/#pricing): 3 scans per week, basic AI (Budsy Flash), plant identification, care reminders, and plant journal — free forever
- [Premium Plan](https://theaiplantdoctor.com/#pricing): $7.99/year — 20 scans per week with weekly credit auto-refresh, advanced AI (Budsy Pro), excellent accuracy, multi-device sync, personalized treatment plans
- [Credit Packs](https://theaiplantdoctor.com/#pricing): 3 credits for $0.99, 10 credits for $2.99, 25 credits for $5.99 — credits never expire

## Plant Problems & Diagnosis Guides

- [Yellow leaves on houseplants — 7 causes and fixes](https://theaiplantdoctor.com/blog/yellow-leaves-on-houseplants/): Overwatering, underwatering, light, nutrient deficiency, sunburn, root rot, natural aging — how to tell them apart
- [Powdery mildew identification and treatment](https://theaiplantdoctor.com/blog/powdery-mildew-identification-treatment/): White powdery coating on leaves, the 4-step baking-soda treatment plan, prevention with airflow and humidity control
- [Brown leaf tips — causes and fixes](https://theaiplantdoctor.com/blog/brown-leaf-tips-causes-fixes/): Low humidity, fluoride/salt buildup, underwatering, fertilizer burn, heat stress — identify by pattern
- [Plant problems glossary A–Z](https://theaiplantdoctor.com/plant-problems/): Index of common houseplant and garden plant diseases, symptoms and pests

## FAQ

- [How accurate is the AI plant diagnosis?](https://theaiplantdoctor.com/#faq): 95%+ accuracy on common diseases, continuously learning and improving with every diagnosis
- [What types of plants are supported?](https://theaiplantdoctor.com/#faq): Over 10,000 species including houseplants, garden plants, trees, succulents, and tropical plants
- [Does the app work offline?](https://theaiplantdoctor.com/#faq): AI diagnosis requires internet; plant journal, care reminders, and saved treatment plans work offline
- [Is my data private and secure?](https://theaiplantdoctor.com/#faq): Photos and data are encrypted, never shared with third parties; only anonymized data improves AI models
- [Can I cancel my premium subscription anytime?](https://theaiplantdoctor.com/#faq): Cancel anytime through App Store or Google Play with no hidden fees
- [How do care reminders work?](https://theaiplantdoctor.com/#faq): Smart reminders based on species needs, customizable frequency, adjusted by season and plant health
